description.narrative: Målet med projektet är att minska korruptionen i Armenien genom att avslöja korruptionsmekanismer och bidra till utvecklingen av effektiva mekanismer för att bekämpa korruption, att förbättra arbetet i anti-korruptionsorgan genom att visa deras brister och luckor, för att belysa befintliga problem på området mänskliga rättigheter och hjälpa relevanta organ att lösa dem.

The goal of the project is to reduce corruption in Armenia by revealing mechanisms of corruption and contributing to development of effective mechanisms to fight corruption, to improve the work of anti-corruption bodies by showing their shortcomings and gaps, to highlight existing problems in the field of human rights protection and help relevant bodies to solve them.

The goal of the project is to reduce corruption in Armenia by revealing mechanisms of corruption and contributing to development of effective mechanisms to fight corruption, to improve the work of anti-corruption bodies by showing their shortcomings and gaps, to highlight existing problems in the field of human rights protection and help relevant bodies to solve them.
Objective 1. To contribute to the transparent and accountable governance through corruption reporting.
Objective 2. To contribute to the protection of human rights through reporting the violations of these rights.
Objective 3. Enhance professional capacities of thirty young journalists in investigative reporting.
Objective 4. To stimulate public discussion about corruption, human rights, and the rule of law.
